call_points.text: Gross margin target of around 30-32%, with margins expected to stay in range for the next quarter or two.

Roadster deliveries lagged orders on 4680-cell shortage; pending vehicles to be delivered over this quarter and the next.
Q1 FY27 orders expected at 40,000 to 45,000 units with consolidated revenue of ₹500 to ₹550 Cr.

operating_notes.text: Ola Electric Technologies allotted a fourth tranche of 0.001% Series A OCRPS to Ola Cell Technologies for ₹127.64 Cr on 27 April 2026, following tranches intimated on 7 October, 30 October and 23 December 2025.
April 2026 registrations were 12,166 units, up 20% MoM from 10,133 in March, while the broader EV 2W industry declined over 22% MoM.
Ola says commercialisation of its 4680 Bharat Cells has boosted cost efficiencies, with benefits passed on to customers.
Ola's S1 X+ 5.2 kWh, powered by its in-house 4680 Bharat Cell, was certified under CMVR by ICAT Manesar, with a 320 km IDC range, 125 km/h top speed and an 11 kW mid-drive motor.
Board approved investment of ₹1,500 Cr in OET and ₹500 Cr in OCT via CCPS at par, to be completed by May 14, 2027.
Q4FY26 operating cash flow turned positive at ₹91 Cr.
Q4 FY26 consolidated gross margins reached 38.5% and operating cash flow turned positive at ₹91 Cr.
May 2026 registrations of 15,139 units were up 23% MoM, against industry growth of about 15% from ~148,000 to ~170,000 units.
FY26 segment loss before finance costs, depreciation, amortisation, exceptional items and tax was ₹785 Cr, with Automotive at ₹(256) Cr and Cell at ₹(116) Cr.
FY26 depreciation, amortisation and finance costs totalled ₹1,044 Cr against ₹932 Cr in FY25.
Unrecognised deferred tax assets were ₹1,438 Cr at 31 March 2026 against carry-forward business losses of ₹6,612 Cr.
Cell yields were in the high-70s to around 80% when production was paused at 2.5 GWh, with a roadmap to above 90% within a quarter of restarting.
About 20% of the auto portfolio will remain NMC-based for higher-performance products, with the rest moving to LFP over time.
The Central Electricity Authority has estimated an energy-storage requirement of about 400 GWh over the next five to six years.

On 22 October 2026, Motilal Oswal Financial Services applied for 12,833,054 rights entitlements renounced by ANI Technologies, and Calliope Capital Advisors LLP applied for 11,022,422 entitlements renounced by Indus Trust.

timeline.summary: Ola Electric shareholders approved the variation in the terms of utilization of IPO proceeds via postal ballot.

Ola Electric Technologies, a material wholly owned subsidiary, allotted a fourth tranche of 12,76,40,000 0.001% Series A OCRPS to fellow subsidiary Ola Cell Technologies for ₹127.64 Cr on 27 April 2026.
ICRA assigned [ICRA]BBB (Negative) to Ola Electric Technologies and [ICRA]BBB- (Negative) to Ola Cell Technologies.
Ola Electric reported April 2026 registrations of 12,166 units, up 20% MoM from 10,133 in March, while the broader EV 2W industry declined over 22%.
Ola Electric said its S1 X+ 5.2 kWh scooter, powered by its in-house 4680 Bharat Cell, received CMVR certification from ICAT Manesar on 8 May 2026, with a 320 km IDC range.
Ola Electric Mobility Limited will host an earnings conference call on May 18, 2026, at 5:00 PM (IST) with Bhavish Aggarwal and Deepak Rastogi.
Ola Electric's board approved capital infusions of ₹1,500 Cr into OET and ₹500 Cr into OCT via preference shares to support business requirements.
Ola Electric Mobility Limited rescheduled its Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings conference call from May 18 to May 20, 2026, at 05:00 PM (IST) due to exigencies.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹265 Cr (-56.6% YoY), net loss ₹500 Cr (against a loss of ₹870 Cr a year earlier).
Ola Electric reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹265 Cr and turned operating cash flow positive at ₹91 Cr.
Ola Electric reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹265 Cr and a net loss of ₹500 Cr.
Abhishek Jain, Company Secretary, uploaded the audio recording of the earnings conference call with analysts/investors on May 20, 2026, for Q4 and FY2026 results.
May 20, 2026: Ola Electric reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹265 Cr, 38.5% gross margin, and ₹91 Cr operating cash flow, while guiding Q1 FY27 orders to 40k-45k units.
2026-06-01: Ola Electric reported May 2026 VAHAN registrations of 15,139 units, up 23% MoM from 12,323 in April and against ~15% industry growth.
2026-06-01: Ola Electric filed audited FY26 consolidated statements showing revenue of ₹2,253 Cr (FY25: ₹4,514 Cr) and a loss of ₹1,833 Cr, with going concern a key audit matter.
Ola Electric opened its Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) with a floor price of ₹37.74 per share.
Ola Electric closed its Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP), raising funds by allotting 217.58 million equity shares at ₹35.86 per share.
Confirmed application by specific investors for 23,855,476 renounced rights entitlements in its rights issue.
Ola Electric closed its ₹1,000 crore rights issue of partly paid-up equity shares on October 30, 2026.
